name: One tooltip at a time through a context service
body:
# One tooltip at a time through a context service

Split from 'Tooltips live in a TooltipArea wrapper, not in the application' (2026-11-05). Today only hover keeps tooltips exclusive, and opening a context menu or dialog doesn't hide one that's showing. Chaos now has `@provide`/`@context`, so a small service can do both without the application.
plan:
1. A `TooltipService` class with a `@signal` field for the area currently showing.
2. A component high in the editor's tree declares `@provide tooltips: TooltipService = new TooltipService();`; `TooltipArea` reads it with `@context tooltips: TooltipService = ...` and claims it when it shows.
3. Menus and dialogs hide the current tooltip through the same service.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a context menu or dialog hides a showing tooltip.
Only one tooltip shows at a time.
